newBlocks.tooltip: Carves out a fixed contiguous item memory storage block in safe user RAM to track weapons or inventory data.
Executes an assembly bit operation to toggle item properties like equipped, consumable, or collected variables fields.
Evaluates two data variables or positions against a mathematical operator condition to trigger logical switches.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({RegisterAlpha})
ld de, {ValueBeta}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr z, _CompareConditionFailed
jr nc, _CompareConditionFailed

newBlocks.tooltip: Performs low-level mathematical operations directly across system variables matrices.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({TargetVariable})
ld de, {ValueDelta}
add hl, de
ld ({TargetVariable}), hl

newBlocks.tooltip: Evaluates the contents of a memory address; forces hard limits to prevent data variables overflow.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({MemoryPointer})
ld de, {AbsoluteFloor}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr nc, _CheckCeiling
ld hl, {AbsoluteFloor}
_CheckCeiling:
ld de, {AbsoluteCeiling}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr c, _ClampDone
ld hl, {AbsoluteCeiling}
_ClampDone:
ld ({MemoryPointer}), hl

newBlocks.tooltip: Runs an assembly and instruction against a selected memory address to gate downstream logic chunks.
Scans active wire connection charts to trace circular logical dependency deadlocks before compilation steps execute.
Runs a symmetric XOR bitwise calculation loop across saved data tables to protect parameters from memory cheat injectors.
Casts look-ahead testing rays away from player positions to locate tiles marked as solid environmental covers for enemy AI masking.
Flushes active progress values, scores counters, and flag tables back to default parameters for a clean New Game reset.
